result.summary: Found several layout and content clipping issues, primarily in the horizontal scrollable card sections where content is cut off at the screen edge.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccolo' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with its name truncated and delivery info partially hidden.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll containers clearly indicate more content is available, or adjust card widths/padding so text isn't abruptly cut off at the viewport edge.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' appears truncated as 'Tokumaru Ramei' due to font rendering or cropping.
issues.suggestion: Verify text rendering and ensure full restaurant name displays correctly without visual truncation.

issues.description: The pizza promotion card at the bottom of the screen is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar, showing only a partial image with no visible title or details.
issues.suggestion: Add proper spacing or a fade/scroll indicator so users understand there is more content below, or adjust scroll boundaries relative to the nav bar.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the pizza promo card is nearly invisible due to low contrast between the white outline icon and the light-colored pizza background.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle background circle or shadow behind the icon to improve visibility against varying image backgrounds.
